title: Eylsia Nicolas rises higher spiritually with “How Many Times 2”
htmlContent: Eylsia Nicolas returns to the Christian country music scene with a soulful, uplifting new single, “How Many Times 2”, a follow-up that is as much a testament to perseverance as it is to faith. This latest release is a journey, one that Eylsia crafted with dedication, heart, and a literal rise in pitch. The inspiration behind “How Many Times 2” is deeply personal. After hours of recording the original track, Eylsia’s voice began to feel the strain, prompting her to sing in a higher range to protect it. That decision, while practical, also added a fresh, resonant energy to the song, giving it a unique sound that sets it apart from typical country Christian fare. But the song’s essence goes beyond vocal technique. On the drive home from recording, Eylsia reflected on the powerful message of the original “How Many Times,” a message of persistence, faith, and striving for excellence. She realized that true artistry requires returning to the work until it aligns perfectly with the heart’s intent. In that spirit, she encouraged everyone involved to revisit, refine, and refine the process until it was right. This commitment shines through in every note and lyric of “How Many Times 2.” The single carries the warmth and storytelling charm of country, infused with inspirational Christian undertones that speak to resilience and devotion. https://open.spotify.com/track/2SA8UPzRw7XxEPP6xzJ1hb The higher range of Eylsia’s vocals protects her voice and elevates the listener, creating an intimate yet expansive listening experience that invites reflection and hope. “How Many Times 2” is a celebration of determination, faith, and artistic integrity. Eylsia Nicolas proves that music is about pouring oneself into the work, trusting the journey, and inspiring others along the way. For fans of country Christian music and anyone searching for a song that uplifts the spirit while telling a genuine human story, “How Many Times 2” is a compelling listen that resonates.
